content: FastMCP stdio in Docker: Known issue (fastmcp #507, closed as not planned) — stdio transport fails with some Docker versions, server closes instantly. Root causes: (1) stdout corruption if anything prints to stdout (JSON-RPC uses stdout for protocol); (2) stdin buffering in Docker. PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 is the critical mitigation. MCP server.py in palimpsest does NOT use print() — good. sys.executable inside container correctly resolves to container Python; env vars (GOOGLE_API_KEY, PYTHONPATH) are inherited by subprocess. Workaround if stdio fails: switch McpToolset to streamable-http transport (requires running MCP server as separate process). Best practice: smoke test the MCP subprocess explicitly inside container before going live.
